name: Trash
description: Notes deleted in the last 30 days (the trash.retentionDays setting), with who deleted them and the days each has left. Restore one (r, or swipe right) and it comes back where it was, with its history. A link to a note in Trash says so, with Restore.

history:read.why: List deleted notes, and show their last version

files:write.why: Restore deleted notes, as changes by you

editor.why: Say so on links to a note that's in Trash
